_notes.status: PLACEHOLDER MENU. Names, descriptions and prices are stand-ins until the real 8848 menu arrives. Curry, tandoor, biryani, bread, dessert and lassi items reuse Natraj Indian Cuisine wording; Nepali, Himalayan, Indo-Chinese and bar items were written for 8848.
_notes.img: Not a file path: an image family key. public/dishes/.jpg. o-* photos are Natraj's own (placeholders, see PLACEHOLDERS.md); p-* photos come from Pexels via scripts/fetch-images.mjs; plain keys are Natraj's Pexels photos. Families without a file render a brass line-art illustration.
_notes.spice: 0 = none, 1 = gentle, 2 = warm, 3 = hot, 4 = very hot, 5 = Himalayan hot.

categories.name: Momo
categories.blurb: Pleated by hand every morning. Served with sesame-tomato achar.

categories.name: Himalayan Small Plates
categories.blurb: Khaja: the snacks you share over a drink before the real food arrives.

categories.name: Noodles & Soups
categories.blurb: What trekkers eat when the wind comes up.

categories.name: Indo-Chinese
categories.blurb: Kathmandu's favourite fusion: wok fire, soy, garlic and green chilli.

categories.name: Nepali Thali & Mains
categories.blurb: Dal bhat power, 24 hour. Thalis come with refills of dal and rice.

categories.name: Tandoor & Curries
categories.blurb: North Indian favourites from the clay oven and the pot. Curries come with basmati rice.

categories.name: Rice & Breads
categories.blurb: Breads are baked to order in the tandoor.

categories.name: Desserts
categories.blurb: Something sweet for the last push.

categories.name: Chiya & Soft Drinks
categories.blurb: Masala chiya is brewed all day.

categories.name: The Bar
categories.blurb: Signature cocktails with Himalayan spice, Nepali lagers, wine and zero-proof pours. 21+ with ID.

items.name: Chicken Momo
items.desc: Steamed dumplings filled with minced chicken, ginger, garlic and cilantro, served with Nepali chutney.

items.name: Veg Momo
items.desc: Steamed dumplings filled with finely chopped cabbage, carrot, onion and spices, served with Nepali chutney.

items.name: Paneer Momo
items.desc: Crumbled paneer with spinach, spring onion and a little cumin, pleated and steamed.

items.name: Lamb Momo
items.desc: Minced lamb with ginger, onion and timur, made the way buff momo is made in Kathmandu.

items.name: Jhol Momo
items.desc: Chicken momos sitting in a warm, tangy broth of roasted tomato, sesame and timur. Drink the broth.

items.name: Kothey Momo
items.desc: Half-moon momos pan-fried on one side until crackly, soft on top. Chicken or veg.

items.name: Fried Momo
items.desc: Chicken momos fried until golden and blistered, with sesame-tomato achar for dipping.

items.name: C-Momo (Chilli Momo)
items.desc: Fried chicken momos stir-fried with bell peppers, onions, garlic and red chilli sauce: crisp, sticky, smoky.

items.name: Chilli Veg Momo
items.desc: Veg momos stir-fried with bell peppers, onions, garlic and red chilli sauce, spicier and crispier with a smoky finish.

items.name: Tandoori Momo
items.desc: Chicken momos marinated in yogurt and tandoori masala, finished in the clay oven with mint chutney.

items.name: Momo Platter
items.desc: Twelve momos, four ways: steamed, kothey, jhol and C-momo. Made for the middle of the table.

items.name: Momo, Your Way
items.desc: Pick the filling and the style in the momo builder. We pleat it to order.

items.name: Chicken Choila
items.desc: Newari grilled chicken tossed with mustard oil, timur, garlic, ginger and fenugreek smoke. With beaten rice.

items.name: Lamb Sukuti
items.desc: Spiced dried lamb, pan-tossed with onion, tomato, green chilli and timur. Our take on buff sukuti.

items.name: Chicken Sekuwa
items.desc: Hill-country skewers marinated in mustard oil, cumin and timur, charred over the grill.

items.name: Lamb Sekuwa
items.desc: Cubes of lamb in ginger, garlic and Himalayan spices, grilled on skewers until smoky at the edges.

items.name: Aloo Sadheko
items.desc: Boiled potatoes tossed with toasted sesame, mustard oil, lemon, green chilli and cilantro.

items.name: Chatpate
items.desc: Kathmandu street snack: puffed rice, potato, onion, cucumber, peanuts, lemon and chilli, mixed to order.

items.name: Sel Roti
items.desc: Sweet ring-shaped rice bread, crisp outside and tender inside, with spiced potato achar.

items.name: Wai Wai Sadheko
items.desc: Crushed instant noodles tossed with onion, tomato, chilli, lime and cilantro. Every Nepali kid's after-school snack.

items.name: Vegetable Samosa
items.desc: Two crispy cone pouches stuffed with mildly spiced potato and peas.

items.name: Vegetable Pakoras
items.desc: Mildly spiced vegetable fritters in chickpea batter.

items.name: Paneer Pakora
items.desc: Homemade cheese dipped in chickpea batter and fried golden.

items.name: Chicken Thukpa
items.desc: Tibetan noodle soup: noodles, chicken and greens in a ginger-garlic broth with a spoon of chilli.

items.name: Veg Thukpa
items.desc: Noodles, bok choy, carrot and mushroom in a clear ginger-garlic broth.

items.name: Lamb Thenthuk
items.desc: Hand-pulled flat noodles in a hearty broth with lamb, spinach and daikon.

items.name: Chicken Chowmein
items.desc: Street-style noodles wok-tossed with cabbage, carrot, onion and soy, the way Kathmandu does it.

items.name: Laphing
items.desc: Chilled mung-bean noodles with chilli oil, garlic, soy and black vinegar. Lhasa street food, served cold.

items.name: Lentil Soup
items.desc: Slow-simmered yellow lentils with ginger, cumin and a squeeze of lemon.

items.name: Chicken Manchow Soup
items.desc: Soy-ginger broth with chicken and vegetables, topped with a crunch of fried noodles.

items.name: Hot & Sour Soup
items.desc: Tofu, mushroom and bamboo shoot in a peppery, vinegary broth.

items.name: Chilli Chicken
items.desc: Crisp boneless chicken wok-tossed with onion, green pepper, green chilli, soy and garlic.

items.name: Chilli Paneer
items.desc: Homemade cheese with diced onion, green pepper and green chilli in a soy-garlic glaze.

items.name: Gobi Manchurian
items.desc: Crisp cauliflower in a glossy garlic-ginger-soy Manchurian sauce with spring onion.

items.name: Dragon Chicken
items.desc: Crispy chicken strips tossed with cashews, peppers and a smoky red chilli sauce.

items.name: Honey Chilli Potatoes
items.desc: Crisp potato fingers in a sticky honey-chilli glaze with toasted sesame.

items.name: Hakka Noodles
items.desc: Wok-tossed noodles with cabbage, peppers, spring onion and a hit of vinegar. Add chicken +$3.

items.name: Schezwan Fried Rice
items.desc: Wok-fired rice with Schezwan chilli paste, egg and vegetables. Add chicken +$3.

items.name: Veg Manchurian
items.desc: Vegetable dumplings in a dark, garlicky Manchurian gravy.

items.name: Chicken Lollipop
items.desc: Frenched chicken wings, crisp and red, with Schezwan dip.

items.name: Dal Bhat Thali
items.desc: The meal that climbs Everest: rice, black lentil dal, seasonal tarkari, saag, achar, papad and something sweet. Refills on dal and rice.

items.name: Khasi Dal Bhat Thali
items.desc: The full thali with bone-in goat curry on the side.

items.name: Khasi ko Masu
items.desc: Goat curry, bone-in, slow-cooked the Nepali way with tomato, ginger, onion and a whisper of timur.

items.name: Kukhura ko Masu
items.desc: Home-style chicken curry with cumin, turmeric and plenty of fresh ginger.

items.name: Aloo Tama Bodi
items.desc: Potato, bamboo shoot and black-eyed peas in a tangy, gently spiced curry.

items.name: Gundruk ko Jhol

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.desc: Boneless chicken leg cooked in tomato and cream sauce with mild spices.

items.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
items.desc: Chicken marinated in ginger, garlic and yogurt, baked in the tandoor and simmered with tomatoes and cream.

items.name: Pistachio Chicken Korma
items.desc: Chicken breast cooked in pistachio, yogurt, tomatoes and gentle spices.

items.name: Lamb Rogan Josh
items.desc: Lamb cubes cooked with tomatoes, freshly ground spices and yogurt.

items.name: Saag Paneer
items.desc: Homemade cheese and spinach, slow-cooked with garlic and garam masala.

items.name: Paneer Tikka Masala
items.desc: Homemade cheese in tomato and cream sauce with fresh ginger and garlic.

items.name: Malai Kofta
items.desc: Vegetable dumplings in a mild creamy sauce with nuts and raisins.

items.name: Chana Masala
items.desc: Chickpeas in a thick, tangy gravy topped with onion, tomato and cilantro.

items.name: Dal Makhani

items.name: Tandoori Chicken
items.desc: Marinated overnight in yogurt and freshly ground spices, then roasted in the clay oven.

items.name: Chicken Tikka
items.desc: Boneless chicken, delicately spiced and charred in the tandoor.

items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.desc: Homemade cheese marinated overnight in yogurt and spices, roasted with peppers and onion.

items.name: Vegetable Biryani
items.desc: Mixed vegetables cooked with basmati, mild spices and nuts. With raita.

items.name: Basmati Rice
items.desc: Fragrant basmati, steamed with saffron.

items.name: Naan
items.desc: Handmade bread baked against the wall of the clay oven.

items.name: Garlic Naan

items.name: Paneer Naan
items.desc: Leavened bread stuffed with homemade cheese and herbs.

items.name: Tandoori Roti
items.desc: Whole-wheat bread baked in the clay oven.

items.name: Bread Basket
items.desc: Garlic naan, plain naan and roti.

items.name: Raita
items.desc: Yogurt with cucumber, cumin and mint.

items.name: Achar Trio

items.name: Kheer

items.name: Chiya Crème Brûlée

items.name: Masala Chiya

items.desc: Bright and citrusy; it calms the heat of C-momo.
